cases.name: a form holds addressable fields, so recognizing the vocabulary ADDS an address

profile = "geml-form/v1"
===

==== form {#signup}

===
====

cases.name: a form-* block outside a form is GEP-0008's error once the vocabulary is recognized; without it, an unknown type
a form-field without name= is GEP-0008's error: the name is the key its handler receives and the step a coordinate addresses it by
a name is unique within its form, a group adds no namespace, and another form may reuse it
a field is addressed by GEP-0011's coordinate on its form or group, and a reference to it says its label; a field needs no id
